articles.summary: The J.M. Smucker Co. (NYSE: SJM) today announced results for the second quarter ended October 31, 2026, of its 2027 fiscal year. All comparisons are to the second quarter of the prior fiscal year, unless otherwise noted. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY Net sales was $2.3 billion, a decrease of $46.9 million, or 2 percent. Net income per diluted share was $2.32. Adjusted earnings per share was $3.20, an increase of 52 percent, which included a $0.22 benefit from tariff refunds received in the quarter. Cash provided by operating activities was $293.8 million compared to $346.5 million in the prior year. Free cash flow was $203.8 million compared to $280.2 million in the prior year. The Company increased its full-year fiscal 2027 earnings outlook, with adjusted earnings per share now ranging from $10.80 to $11.20. articles.summary: The J.M. Smucker Co. (NYSE: SJM) will release its second quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. A press release, including financial statements and segment information, supplemental materials, pre-recorded management remarks, and a transcript of the pre-recorded remarks will be available beginning at 7:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time. The Company will webcast a live question and answer session with Mark Smucker, Chief Executive Officer, President and Chair of the Board, and Tucker Marshall, Chief Financial Officer | Executive Vice President, Frozen Handheld and Spreads and Sweet Baked Snacks, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time on that date.
